- Downloads: a link of the Stremio server on the phone (http://127.0.0.1:11470/<hash>/<file number>?tr=...) was saved as "64", the number at the end of the link. The real name of the video is now asked from the server; without it the file is named "video-<hash>-<number>". A file whose name has no extension gets one from the content type (video/mp4 -> .mp4, video/x-matroska -> .mkv ...).
- Downloads from a player app ("external player" in Stremio): the start no longer waits for the video's name (it is asked once the stream answers, and the file is named video-<hash>-<number> until then); a torrent stream is fetched on one connection, in order, instead of eight at once (it started slowly); the wait for the first bytes may last up to two and a half minutes instead of thirty seconds.
- Downloads: a link to an HLS playlist (.m3u8) saved the playlist text, not the video. The playlist is now read, the best quality is picked, and its pieces are downloaded in order (four at a time) into one .ts file (.mp4 for fragmented MP4); AES-128 encrypted pieces are decrypted; the percent follows the pieces.
- Downloads: several links pasted together (one per line, or run on) are all taken at once, so the links of a whole season go in with one press.
- Downloads: a "Series and movies" card: name a show or a movie (Cinemeta, the catalogue the Stremio apps use; the posters are shown as they are found) and an add-on link, set the largest size (800 MB at first), pick a movie or a season: for every episode the largest stream under that size is found and downloaded, named "Show S01E02" ("Movie (Year)"). Torrent streams are downloaded by the torrent engine inside Pulse (no other app needed); without it (lite build, 32-bit phones) they go through the Stremio app's server on the phone, which Pulse opens by itself when it is not running. Pulse brings no add-on of its own.
- Downloads: a Paste button beside the add-on link.
- Downloads: a torrent engine in the full build (libtorrent, 64-bit phones only, about 7 MB more; the lite build has none): magnet links pasted in the link field, shared, or opened from a browser (Pulse takes magnet: links) download like any file: only the wanted file of the torrent is fetched, into one file, with progress, pause and resume; nothing is seeded afterwards.
- Keyboard: in an e-mail field, typing the first letters of an address you used before ("umut") offers your saved addresses that begin so; the system autofill chips, which kept showing other addresses, step aside once you type.
- Downloads, Series and movies: laid out in three labelled steps (1 add-on, 2 size, 3 find); the size is chosen from buttons (500 MB … 6 GB) instead of a bare number box; a saved add-on shows as "✓ host" with a Change button; Series / Movies show which one is on; choosing a show hides the other results and its seasons ("Season 1 · 10 ep") or its Download button come right under it (they were below a long list and looked as if nothing opened).
- Series and movies: a season now opens its episode list: pick a season, then "Download season N · x of y episodes" (everything ticked by default, the largest stream under the size limit is picked for each by itself); episodes can be ticked or unticked, All / None, and the arrow on an episode downloads only that one.
- Series: each episode shows its own picture (the catalogue's thumbnail; without it the series poster; without that its number) and its summary.
- Series and movies: a list that changed kept the posters of the list before (a search for another show showed the old covers); fixed, here and in the gallery grid. Any link of an add-on is accepted (its "stremio://" link, its configure page, its site address): Pulse turns it into the manifest address itself, and takes the link from what you copied when the card is opened, so nothing has to be pasted by hand.
- Series: the search for streams works with the long add-on address (its "|" is sent encoded), keeps the colons of an episode id as the apps do, and accepts a torrent stream that names no file number (the biggest file is taken); when no stream is under the size limit, the smallest one there is is taken (marked with an arrow), so no episode is left out.
- Series: every season has a card with the poster; opening a season shows its episodes first, each with its picture, its summary and the size of the stream that would be taken, and only then "Download season" or the arrow of one episode.
- Downloads: the "The \"This isn't a hierarchical URI\"" error on magnet links is fixed (the link's parts are read by hand); the bar of chosen rows (delete, select all) floats at the bottom and stays in reach while the list scrolls.
